title: The Wake Up
caps: A short practice to clear the fog
and set the tone of your day.
We'll move through three breathing techniques,
The second technique is breath of fire.
We finish with a breath hold
and let's begin this morning practice together.
We'll start with four seconds in
In and out through the nose.
Take a big inhale through the nose,
fill up the lungs and hold.
And with a big sigh, exhale.
Hold your breath on empty lungs for 30 seconds.
Take a big inhale through your nose.
Let your breath come back to its normal rhythm.
Before you step into the day,
Think of one thing you're grateful for today.
The fact that you showed up here today for yourself,
Just one word for how you want to move through today.
Whatever came to your mind first,
I wish you a beautiful day
and thank you for being here.
See you in the next session.
